name: Taberipp
author: wpmiyake

sections.description:
Taberipp is a WordPress plugin for food bloggers in Japan. It lets you create beautiful restaurant card blocks that link to major Japanese restaurant reservation and review sites with affiliate links.

No external API required. All restaurant information (name, image, address, and URLs) is entered manually. When a Tabelog URL is set, review and map links are automatically generated.

Supported Affiliate Services

  • Tabelog (ValueCommerce)
  • Ikyu Restaurant (ValueCommerce)
  • HotPepper Gourmet (ValueCommerce)
  • Hitosara (ValueCommerce)
  • Retty (A8.net)

Card Display Items

  • Restaurant image
  • Restaurant name (links to main service)
  • Sub-text
  • Address with map link (auto-generated from Tabelog URL)
  • Review link (auto-generated from Tabelog URL)
  • Reservation buttons (up to 3 columns on desktop, 1 column on mobile)

How to Use

  1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Taberipp > Settings and enter your affiliate IDs (ValueCommerce SID/PID and A8.net a8mat).
  3. Go to Taberipp > Restaurant List and click “Add New” to register a restaurant.
  4. In the edit screen, enter the restaurant name, image URL, address, and service URLs, then save.
  5. Insert the restaurant card using the shortcode [taberipp id=”XXX”] or the Gutenberg block.

Notes

  • Even without affiliate IDs configured, buttons are displayed and link to each service’s top page.
  • The review and map links auto-generated from Tabelog URLs may break if Tabelog changes their URL structure.
  • Please review and comply with the terms of service of each affiliate network you use.

External Services

This plugin allows users to add affiliate links to external restaurant reservation and review services. No data is automatically sent to these services — links are only followed when a user clicks a button.

Affiliate Networks

ValueCommerce (https://www.valuecommerce.ne.jp/)
Used to generate affiliate tracking links for Tabelog, Ikyu Restaurant, HotPepper Gourmet, and Hitosara. When a user clicks a reservation button, they are redirected through ValueCommerce’s tracking URL.
– What is sent: The affiliate SID/PID configured by the site owner, plus the destination URL.
– When: Only when a visitor clicks a button.
– Terms of Service: https://www.valuecommerce.ne.jp/st_affiliate/terms.html
– Privacy Policy: https://www.valuecommerce.co.jp/privacy_policy/

A8.net (https://www.a8.net/)
Used to generate affiliate tracking links for Retty. When a user clicks the Retty button, they are redirected through A8.net’s tracking URL.
– What is sent: The affiliate a8mat parameter configured by the site owner, plus the destination URL.
– When: Only when a visitor clicks a button.
– Terms of Service: https://www.a8.net/compliance/media-userpolicy.php
– Privacy Policy: https://www.a8.net/privacy.html

External Restaurant Services

The following third-party services may be linked from restaurant cards. No data is sent to these services by the plugin itself — the links simply direct visitors to the respective websites when clicked.

  • Tabelog – https://tabelog.com/ (Terms: https://tabelog.com/help/rules | Privacy: https://tabelog.com/help/rules)
  • Retty – https://retty.me/ (Terms: https://retty.me/announce/tos/ | Privacy: https://retty.me/announce/privacy/)
  • Ikyu Restaurant – https://restaurant.ikyu.com/ (Terms: https://www.ikyu.com/terms/service/ | Privacy: https://www.ikyu.co.jp/policy)
  • HotPepper Gourmet – https://www.hotpepper.jp/ (Terms: https://www.hotpepper.jp/doc/pc/20200326/terms.html | Privacy: https://hotpepper.jp/doc/terms.html)
  • Hitosara – https://hitosara.com/ (Terms: https://usen.media/rules/hitosara/ | Privacy: https://hitosara.com/info/privacy.html)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via WordPress admin > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Taberipp > Settings to configure your affiliate information.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use any external APIs?

No. All restaurant information (name, image, address, and URLs for each service) is entered manually by the user.

What is automatically generated from the Tabelog URL?

A review link (/dtlrvwlst/) and a map link (/dtlmap/) are automatically generated. If ValueCommerce affiliate IDs are set, these links will include the affiliate tracking code.

What is the difference from Hotelipp?

Hotelipp is designed for hotels and accommodation, while Taberipp is designed for restaurants. Hotelipp automatically fetches hotel data from the Rakuten Travel API, while Taberipp uses manual data entry without any external API.
